sections.title: Get a new authentication token
sections.text:
POST /v1/users/refresh_jwt

Generate a new JSON Web Token (JWT) for authentication.

Takes a valid token and returns the new token generated by the request.

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request POST /v1/users/refresh_jwt #### Request headers | Key | Value | Description | |-----|-------|-------------| | Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name | | Authorization | JWT eyJ5bGciOiKIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.

leHAiOjE0NjU0Nz30OTZ9.2xYXumd1rDoE0e

dFzcLElMOHsshaqQk2HUNgdsUKxMU | Valid JSON Web Token (JWT) | #### Request body | Field | Type | Description | |-------|------|-------------| | ttl | integer | Time to live - The amount of time in seconds the token will be valid (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a JSON object that contains the generated access token.

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | A new token is given. |
| [401 Unauthorized](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.2) | The token is invalid or password has expired. |
